spans.s:
r. 1st and 6th cls. (इ.) उच्छि (उञ्छति)
1 To glean.
2 To gather little by little.
(ई.) उच्छी (उच्छति) or usually with वि prefixed, (व्युच्छति)
1 To end or terminate, to leave off.
2 To finish or conclude.
3 To pass or quit.
4 To bind.
With प्र,
to wipe off.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Destroyed.
m. (-न्नः)
Peace obtained by ceding valuable lands.
E.
उत् before षद to go, affix क्त.

mfn. (-लन्-लंती-लत्)
Going or moving on or against.
E.
उद, शल to go, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Going upon.
2 Having over, or above, or against.
E.
उद before शल, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
Cleaning with perfumes.
E.
उत्, छद to cover, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Waved, waved above.
2 Gone, went.
3 Shaken.
E.
उद and शल to go, causal form, क्त aff.

mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति)
Transgressing, deviating from the ritual.
E.
उद् before शास्त्र scripture, वर्त्तिन् who abides.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खं)
1 Flaming, blazing up.
2

Radiant.
3

High crested.
E.
उद् up, शिखा a flame.

n. (-नं)
Breathing through the nostrils, snuffing, snoring.
E.
उत् and शिघि to smell, ल्युट् aff.

ind.
Having cut off, destroyed, killed, &c.
E.
उद् before छिद to cut, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Cut, cut off or cut.
2 Destroyed, killed.
E.
उद् and छिन्न cut.

n. (-न्ध्रं)
A mushroom.
E.
उत् and शिलीन्ध्र.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Left, rejected as food; (i. e. spit out of the mouth, or orts, crumbs, fragments, &c.)
2 Left, abandoned.
E.
उत् up, शिष to leave as a residue, and क्त aff.

m. (-नः)
1 One who eats another's leavings.
2 The attendant upon an idol, whose food is the leavings of the deities.
E.
उच्छिष्ट orts, and भोजन food.

mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि)
Who eats the remains of a meal.
E.
उच्छिष्ट and भोजिन् who eats.

n. (-नं)
Wax.
E.
उच्छिष्ट and मोदन pleasing.

n. (-न्नं)
Leaving, offal.
E.
उच्छिष्ट and अन्न food.

n. (-कं)
A pillow.
E.
उत् upon, and शीर्षक the head: on which rests the head.

mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं)
Dry, dried up, withered.
E.
उद् before शुष्क dried.

f. (-डा)
The head of a banner or part above the flag with erect ornaments.
E.
उत् up, छूडा crest.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Swollen, turgid.
2 Lofty, high.
3 Fat, bulky.
E.
उत् up, श्वि to increase, क्त affix, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Unrestrained, perverse, self-willed.
2 Irregular, desultory, unmethodical.
E.
उत् priv. and शृङ्क्षला a chain.

m. (-दः)
1 Cutting off or out.
2 Destroying, destruction.
3 Cutting short, putting an end to.
4 Excision.
E.
उद् and छिद cutting.

n. (-णं)
1 Rest, remainder.
2 Leavings.
E.
उत् and शेषण remaining.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
What dries up or withers.
n. (-णं)
Drying up, parching.
E.
उद् and शोषण drying.

m. (-यः)
1 Height, elevation of a tree, mountain, &c.
2 Rising of a planet, &c.
3 Upright side of a triangle.
E.
उत् up, श्रिञ् to serve, च्यच् aff.

m. (-यः)
Height, elevation.
E.
उत् before श्रि to serve, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
High raised, lofty.
E.
उच्छ्राय and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Born, produced.
2 High, tall.
2 Lifted up, raised.
4 Prosperous, advancing, increasing, rising.
5 Left, abandoned.
6 Increased in size or bulk, grown.
E.
उत्, श्रिञ् to serve, क्त aff.

f. (-तिः)
1 Height, elevation.
2 The upright side of a triangle.
E.
उत् before श्रि to serve, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
High, lofty.
E.
उत् before श्रि to serve, यत् affix.

Breathing.
2

Sighing.
E.
उत् before श्वस to breathe, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Blown, expanded.
2 Breathed, inspired.
3 Sighing.
E.
उत् much, &c. श्वसित breathed, blown.

m. (-सः)
1 Breath, breathing, inspiration.
2 A sigh.
3 Consolation, encouragement.
4 Division of a book.
E.
उत् up, and श्वस to breathe, घञ् aff.
